Plans per day by instance (contract §2.F)
panels.description: Daily plan_journal write count split by planner_instance audit label. Bars stack to show total throughput; labels are historical audit metadata under Hermes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
       COALESCE(planner_instance, 'unknown') AS instance,
       count(*)::int AS plans
  FROM plan_journal
 WHERE created_at > $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo()
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: SLA breaches (last 24h)
panels.description: Count of planner_trigger_log rows that transitioned to status='timed_out' in the panel time range. Sparkline shows daily trend. Big number = today's count only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', delivered_at) AS time,
       count(*)::int AS "Timed out"
  FROM plan_delivery_log
 WHERE status = 'timed_out'
   AND delivered_at > $__timeFrom() AND delivered_at < $__timeTo()
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Plan-write latency by instance (trigger_id join)
panels.description: Distribution of seconds between plan_delivery_log.delivered_at and the matching plan_journal.created_at, one series per planner_instance audit label. Tail on the right = slow cycles. Bucketed at 5-second resolution.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(pj.planner_instance, 'unknown') AS instance,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM pj.created_at - ptl.delivered_at)::float AS latency_seconds
  FROM plan_journal pj
  JOIN plan_delivery_log ptl ON ptl.trigger_id = pj.trigger_id
 WHERE pj.created_at > $__timeFrom() AND pj.created_at < $__timeTo()
   AND pj.created_at >= ptl.delivered_at
 ORDER BY 2

options.content:
### Controlled experiment — blinded ops board (#587, audit §8.7/§8.10)

Skeleton panels for the controlled planner experiment. The backing tables land with **Lane B (migration 207)**: `control_assignments`, `policy_delivery_outbox`, `policy_device_snapshots`, `policy_exposures`. Until then the stat/table panels below intentionally return NULL (their real SQL is staged in each panel description).

**Blinded fields ONLY (visible during the run):**
- opaque assignment id (UUID, no arm meaning)
- activation receipt (device-echoed generation acknowledged)
- expected-vs-confirmed identity equality (boolean)
- exposure coverage fraction + close/fallback reason
- delivery lag (outbox enqueue -> device activation)
- safety/fallback + protocol-deviation events
- tested-rollback receipt (last baseline-recovery drill)

**NEVER on this board while an experiment runs:** arm labels or the X/Y->A/B mapping, template content hashes, component values, or any efficacy/outcome metric. The outcome analysis role is blinded by construction (§8.7); this board must not leak what the database refuses.

panels.title: Exposure coverage (7d)
panels.description:
PENDING Lane B (migration 207). Staged SQL:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (upper(confirmed_interval) - lower(confirmed_interval)))) / (7*86400.0), 0) AS coverage
FROM policy_exposures
WHERE lower(confirmed_interval) > now() - interval '7 days';
Blinded: coverage only — no arm, no content identity.

targets.rawSql:
-- pending Lane B (migration 207): policy_exposures; staged SQL in panel description
SELECT NULL::float8 AS coverage;

panels.title: Expected = confirmed (24h)
panels.description:
PENDING Lane B (migration 207). Staged SQL:
SELECT BOOL_AND(expected_activation_hash = observed_activation_hash) AS identity_ok
FROM policy_device_snapshots
WHERE snapshot_at > now() - interval '24 hours';
Blinded: equality boolean only — the hashes themselves NEVER render here.

targets.rawSql:
-- pending Lane B (migration 207): policy_device_snapshots; staged SQL in panel description
SELECT NULL::boolean AS identity_ok;

panels.title: Assignment receipts (opaque)
panels.description:
PENDING Lane B (migration 207). Staged SQL:
SELECT a.assignment_id, o.activated_at, o.activated_at - o.enqueued_at AS delivery_lag, e.close_reason
FROM control_assignments a
LEFT JOIN policy_delivery_outbox o USING (assignment_id)
LEFT JOIN policy_exposures e USING (assignment_id)
ORDER BY a.assigned_range DESC LIMIT 20;
Blinded: opaque UUIDs, receipts, lag, close/fallback reason — no arm, no X/Y, no content hash, no component values.

SELECT NULL::uuid AS assignment_id, NULL::timestamptz AS activated_at, NULL::interval AS delivery_lag, NULL::text AS close_reason WHERE FALSE;
